card.name: Numbers after retinoid drug names
card.fires_on: The space, decimal point or first digit of a strength or dose number right after a retinoid name such as tretinoin, tazarotene, isotretinoin or adapalene. It is most common in gel strengths like 0.025% or 0.05%.

modes.label: Gel strength decimals
modes.description: The decimal point or space inside a percentage strength after a retinoid gel name.
modes.example: Clindamycin Phosphate 1.2% and Tretinoin 0<<.>>025% Gel should be kept

modes.label: Dose numbers for retinoid capsules
modes.description: The space or digit before or inside a mg dose or duration after a retinoid capsule name.
modes.example: The recommended dosage of tretinoin capsules is<< >>22.5 mg/m 2

card.plain: It fires on the number being written right after a retinoid drug name, such as the strength of a tretinoin or tazarotene gel.
